create_blog_post.label: Create Blog Post
create_blog_post.description: Creates a blog post. Saved as a draft unless a status is given.

status.label: Status
status.description: Leave empty to save the post as a draft. "Scheduled (future)" needs a Publish Date.

date.label: Publish Date
date.description: Publish date in the site's timezone, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2030-01-31T09:00:00). A past date with status "future" publishes immediately.

featured_media.label: Featured Media ID
featured_media.description: ID of an uploaded image to use as the featured image. Get it from upload_media or list_media.

author.label: Author ID
author.description: User ID of the author. Get it from list_users or get_current_user. Leave empty for the connected user.

ping_status.label: Pingbacks
ping_status.description: Whether the post accepts pingbacks and trackbacks.

categories.label: Category IDs
categories.description: Category IDs from list_categories or create_category.

tags.label: Tag IDs
tags.description: Tag IDs from list_tags or create_tag.

sticky.label: Sticky
sticky.description: Whether the post is pinned to the top of the blog.

format.label: Format

acf.label: Custom ACF Fields
